Learn in context

Education built around
real responsibility.

PMU is technical, creative and deeply personal. Browlicious Academy keeps the focus on informed consultation, mapped design, controlled application and practical aftercare—not shortcuts.

  • Small-class guidance and feedback-led practice
  • Skin, colour and treatment planning theory
  • Supervised live-model learning where available
  • Support as you continue building your practice

The learning path

Build the skill.
Understand the why.

Course availability, format and prerequisites can be confirmed directly with the academy.

01

Core foundations

Hygiene, skin anatomy, colour theory, workstation preparation and a consultation framework.

02

Design & technique

Facial mapping, pigment selection, device handling, pressure and technique-specific practice.

03

Client experience

Informed consent, expectations, aftercare and recognising when to refer or decline treatment.

04

Practice & progress

Guided feedback, portfolio thinking and continuing professional development.
